name: comprehensive-enrichment
description: Fixed 12-call, read-only person + company enrichment bundle across Apollo, Hunter, Clado contacts, Orthogonal Company Enrich, Diffbot KG, Exa, and Firecrawl. Requires a complete, internally consistent set of person and company identifiers; every step runs independently through the SELAT Router over MPP on Tempo.

email.description: Known person work email belonging to the same person named by firstName/lastName and linkedinUrl. Drives email enrichment and verification.

firstName.description: Person first name, matching email and linkedinUrl.

lastName.description: Person last name, matching email and linkedinUrl.

company.description: Employer/company name corresponding to domain and pricingUrl.

domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com, matching company and pricingUrl.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn person profile URL for the same person; sent to Apollo people-enrichment and Clado contacts.

pricingUrl.description: Public HTTPS company pricing/features page (non-empty), on the same company domain when possible. Firecrawl is always called with it.

steps.label: person enrichment — Apollo people-enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
email enrich — Hunter email-enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
find work email — Hunter email-finder (MPP on Tempo)
verify supplied email — Hunter email-verifier (MPP on Tempo)
contacts lookup by LinkedIn URL — Clado contacts, no paid enrichment flags (MPP on Tempo)
person research — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
company overview — Orthogonal Company Enrich by domain (MPP on Tempo)
company emails — Hunter domain-search, 10 results (MPP on Tempo)
funding + investors — Diffbot KG enhance (MPP on Tempo)

body.prompt: Extract all products, pricing tiers, and features

steps.label: company research — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)

body.query: ${company} recent news funding announcements partnerships press releases
